title: How is Diddy connected to George Washington?
description:
Two real photos link Diddy to Barack Obama, and the line of presidents runs from Obama back to George Washington.

Sean Combs → Donald Trump → Barack Obama → George Washington

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
